## Appearance and Fonts {.i-palette}

Appearance follows the system, or stays light or dark. The accent is one
of seven colors: periwinkle, orchid, rose, amber, moss, jade or teal.
Fonts offers eight faces for the chat and four monospace faces for code
and the terminal, all under the Open Font License, with one text size
for all three.

## New sessions {.i-sparkles}

Each agent's mode, model and effort to start with. The pills under the
composer change them for one session.

## Composer, Terminal, Files {.i-settings}

Each has its own switches: which key sends and which languages are
spell-checked; the terminal's color scheme, its cursor, and whether a
selection copies itself; format on save and its formatters.

## Updates and About {.i-refresh}

Updates checks daily, or when you ask, and installs the new version
itself. About shows which version this is and who makes it.
